evals.name: completed-research-task-match
evals.prompt: Audit this Research event before a possible title cleanup. Fixture: event E is on the Research calendar and links to Task T; T is Complete. The event text says 'send final paper to advisor'. Do not write. Use the currently approved Calendar rules.
evals.expected_output: Keep the event from reopening or associating it as active work; report the completed task and avoid changing status. Preserve the existing event.
expectations: Never reopens a Complete task or changes it to In Progress.
Uses verified identity instead of creating a duplicate task.
Keeps the fixture read-only and reports the unresolved event intent if needed.

evals.name: planning-versus-calendar-near-miss
evals.prompt: Help me decide whether to schedule two or three manuscript sessions next week. Fixture: project priority is Core, figure task is ready, data task is blocked, and saved Rhythm mapping shows two research blocks. I want a recommendation, not event changes.
evals.expected_output: Use Calendar/Rhythm only for relevant capacity context, separate candidate work from progress, recommend a feasible schedule without writing events or records.
expectations: Uses capacity as a constraint, not as proof of completion.
Does not schedule or edit anything when the user asked only for a recommendation.
Keeps blocked data work from being treated as ready.
